item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Caleb Gourley, a game developer studying at the University of Canterbury.

I’m a fourth-year Bachelor of Digital Screen with Honours student specialising in game development. I have experience in gameplay programming, real-time networking, backend systems, deployment, bug fixing and technical problem-solving. I enjoy building reliable systems that support engaging player experiences and working collaboratively across disciplines.

I’m seeking an entry-level gameplay-programming, technical-design or tools-programming opportunity in the games industry.
